title: Normalized ordinary open restriction agrees with ambient module pullback
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme V and any open U. For the coefficient-normalized ordinary restriction of [def-pur-open-completed-restriction-data] and actual ambient completed-integral pullback of [lem-pur-normalized-integral-pullback-tower], there is a natural isomorphism between ordinaryRestriction(U to V) and IntegralAmbient.pull(U to V), on all module sheaves. No clopen, completeness or boundedness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: lemma-pullback-module (Tag 03D2), lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules (Tag 03D7), lemma-push-pull-composition-modules (Tag 03D8), lemma-tensor-product-pullback (Tag 03EL); sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 06YY. Step 1 of lem-fix-clopen-integral-completion-restriction.

proof.text: Transpose the inverses of the normalized coefficient isomorphisms under the composition/base-change site adjunction. At finite level the transpose is the specified constant-section map, by naturality of sheafification and the constant normalization. The completed transpose commutes with every finite projection; coefficientMap_existsUnique identifies it with the actual completed ambient coefficient map. The ringed-site module adjunction and leftAdjointUniq give ordinaryPullIso from exact restriction to IntegralAmbient.pull.

theorem clopenOrdinaryPullbackComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]

    (V : Scheme.{u}) (U : V.Opens) :
